architecture.effect_plane: receipt-capable disposable GitHub and S3 provider adapters
architecture.memory_plane: CockroachDB outcome-gated vector memory with same-scope RLS

story.headline: Failed outcomes must not become future memory

scenes.caption: Raw retrieval can compound a provider failure into the next action.
scenes.narration: An agent can sound confident and still be wrong. The dangerous moment is not one failed action; it is when that failed outcome becomes trusted memory and silently changes every action that follows.
scenes.title: A failed action must not become memory

scenes.caption: Three sealed time clusters · 36 chains · 540 external-provider observations.
scenes.narration: We preregistered three time-separated blind batches, thirty-six memory chains, and five hundred forty observations across stateless, raw RAG, and Continuum. Bedrock generated hidden variants, while disposable GitHub and S3 adapters produced real receipts.
scenes.title: The same hidden incidents, executed for real

scenes.caption: Target successes — Stateless 105/144 · Raw RAG 102/144 · Continuum 114/144.
scenes.narration: On the one hundred forty-four future target episodes per arm, stateless succeeded 105 times, raw RAG 102, and Continuum 114. Continuum gained 8.33 percentage points over raw RAG in the paired comparison.
scenes.title: Verified memory improves future action

scenes.caption: Raw RAG promoted 48 failed outcomes and exposed unsafe memory 89 times.
scenes.narration: The mechanism is visible, not inferred. Raw RAG canonically promoted 48 failed outcomes, then exposed unsafe memory 89 times and cited it in forty-three actions. Continuum never exposed an unsafe memory.
scenes.title: Raw RAG remembers the wrong thing

scenes.caption: Continuum blocked 38 unsafe proposals · false promotions 0 · promotion precision 100%.
scenes.narration: Continuum did not depend on a perfect model. It generated 38 unsafe proposals, but the verified outcome gate rejected them. Only successful provider receipts became canonical memory, producing 113 verified-memory-assisted successes with zero false promotions.
scenes.title: Provider receipts decide what earns trust

scenes.caption: Evaluator crash → exact artifact replay → candidate reruns 0 → author re-signatures 0.
scenes.narration: The first evaluator runner failed before scoring because Python three point ten lacked StrEnum. Reconciliation replayed the exact candidate artifact under Python three point twelve. It did not regenerate a case, rerun a provider action, or request another author signature.
scenes.title: Crash recovery preserves the candidate

scenes.caption: Bedrock proposes · provider receipts prove · CockroachDB RLS and vector memory promote.
scenes.narration: Bedrock can only propose bounded actions. Provider receipts establish the actual effect. CockroachDB stores the episode contract, isolates tenant scope with row-level security, and retrieves only outcome-verified vector memory for the next incident.
scenes.title: A causal contract, not a similarity score

scenes.caption: Immutable hackathon-v14 · envelope 8c880fa4908e0405… · public gate PASS.
scenes.narration: Every number in this story resolves to immutable release hackathon-v14. Its envelope begins 8c880fa4908e0405. The public verifier checks the sequential artifact, workflow lineage, transaction coordinator, and terminal Pages receipt before it can show PASS.
scenes.title: One click verifies the release

scenes.caption: Continuum Memory Firewall turns provider evidence into safer future action.
scenes.narration: The result is a memory system that learns from verified outcomes, not persuasive text. Similarity retrieves candidates. Provider evidence decides which memories earn trust. Continuum turns that causal distinction into safer future action.
scenes.title: Similarity retrieves. Outcomes earn trust.
